scope: Shared docking panel for task logs and diagnostics

validation.visualAcceptance: No screenshots or pixel comparison; visual review remains with the user

assertions: Window menu opens task logs or diagnostics in the existing bottom dock; attributes retain their own tab and entry points
Ant Design tables, tabs, status filters, details, copy controls, descriptions and collapsible environment section
Actual import parsing and confirmation are distinct logged operations; malformed imports produce failed records
Log cancellation aborts a real pending import worker; clearing completed records preserves active cancellation controls
Processing and geometry-check tasks link caller cancellation, panel cancellation and project replacement to the same worker
3D resource loading transitions create bounded records without logging every render; failed resources navigate to their source inspector
Diagnostic counts derive from project snapshots and public runtime diagnostics; unknown/loading/ready/failure remain distinct
Real browser clipboard readback verifies copied task details and structured diagnostics
URL credentials, sensitive query parameters and authorization headers are redacted from copied errors and resource addresses
Completed history is capped at 200 while retaining active tasks; terminal records reject late completion updates
Project replacement isolates old records; diagnostics, filters, copy and docking preserve project snapshots, dirty flags and undo state
Existing full-canvas geometry, docking restoration, Cesium identity and all four import formats remain covered
boundaries: Logs are in-memory and scoped to a project epoch, not persisted project history or a complete audit log
Per-resource 3D loads do not expose a cancel control because the current resource loader has no independent cancel contract
2D remote-service tile health remains unknown when the runtime provides no reliable aggregate load state
No invented FPS or GPU-memory metrics; existing WebGL context and actual managed-object counters are read only
Native clipboard, Windows 125 percent scaling and physical GPU performance are not signed off by browser E2E
Global drawing/editing/measurement tool-session coordination remains a separate next task
